summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing that at its July 13, 2026 annual general meeting, shareholders approved all proposals outlined in the prior proxy statement, including the amendment of the compensation policy for executive officers and directors. No special-situation transaction—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—is described. The filing is a routine report of shareholder meeting results and the adoption of a revised compensation plan, which does not qualify as a special situation.
